SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.391657, -94.808776 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description****THIS IS 48-HOUR PHMSA UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1388944**** UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: THE CALLER STATES ON 1/14/24, THE ESTHERVILLE LNG PEAK SHAVING PLANT LOCATED IN ESTHERVILLE, IA WENT INTO EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN. THE ESD WAS DUE TO EXTREME WINTER TEMPERATURES, -22 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT, AND THE LACK OF NATURAL GAS FLOW THROUGH THE SYSTEM. THERE WAS NO DEMAND FOR LNG VAPORIZATION, WHICH ALLOWED LIQUID NATURAL GAS TO REACH THE SENSOR, THAT PREVENTS GAS FROM ENTERING THE GAS/FIRE VAPORIZER IN THE EVENT THAT THE GAS IS TOO COLD. THE ESD WAS TRIGGERED AT 0219 HOURS, THE SYSTEM WORKED AS DESIGNED, NO RELEASE OF GAS, AND SERVICE WAS RESTORED AT 0412 HOURS. ORIGINAL REPORT CALLER IS REPORTING A LNG FACILITY SHUTDOWN DUE TO A 15,000 GALLON TANK THAT TRIGGERED AN ALARM, AND WENT INTO AN EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN DUE TO LOW TANK PRESSURE. ON SCENE TECHNICIANS CONFIRMED THEIR HAVE BEEN NO RELEASE OF MATERIALS, AND NO POTENTIAL FOR A RELEASE. FACILITY IS OPERATIONAL, BUT IS STILL UNDER INVESTIGATION.
